title: Like The Beast
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tomoharu Ueda is a contented neighborhood police officer; Aki Gotouda, heir to a yakuza group, comes to thank him for catching an underwear thief and confesses that he has feelings for him (Futekiya blurb via AniList). Their 'forbidden relationship' between a cop and a yakuza becomes an established, affectionate couple facing crime, shootings and Aki's family pressure (blurb; Geekiary review of a later chapter). Long-running adult BL series (18 volumes in Japan, ongoing); MangaDex rates it erotica and MU lists the Yaoi genre.
life_message: Steadfast, affectionate love can hold across opposite worlds and social barriers.
